description: These crispy, golden churros are a beloved Mexican treat, perfect for dipping into a rich, warm chocolate sauce. Made from a simple dough and fried to perfection, they are dusted with cinnamon sugar for an irresistible crunch. This classic dessert brings the vibrant flavors of Mexico right to your table, ideal for sharing with family and friends.

instructions.title: Prepare the Churro Dough Base
instructions.text: In a medium saucepan, combine the water, butter, 1 tablespoon of sugar, and salt. Bring the mixture to a rolling boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat immediately.

instructions.title: Add Flour and Form Dough
instructions.text: Add the all-purpose flour all at once to the hot liquid. Stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until a smooth ball of dough forms and pulls away from the sides of the pan. Return to low heat for 1 minute, stirring constantly to dry out the dough slightly.

instructions.title: Incorporate the Egg
instructions.text: Transfer the dough to a mixing bowl and let it cool for 5 minutes. Add the large egg and beat with a wooden spoon or an electric mixer until the egg is fully incorporated and the dough is smooth and glossy. The dough will be thick.

instructions.title: Heat Oil and Prepare Coating
instructions.text: Pour the vegetable oil into a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, to a depth of about 2-3 inches. Heat the oil to 350F (175C). While the oil heats, combine the remaining 1/2 cup granulated sugar and ground cinnamon in a shallow dish for coating the churros.

instructions.title: Pipe and Fry the Churros
instructions.text: Spoon the churro dough into a large piping bag fitted with a large star tip (like an Ateco 826 or 827). Carefully pipe 4-6 inch strips of dough directly into the hot oil, using kitchen shears or a knife to cut the dough. Fry for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy. Do not overcrowd the pot.

instructions.title: Coat and Prepare Chocolate Sauce
instructions.text: Remove the fried churros with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil. Immediately roll the warm churros in the cinnamon sugar mixture until fully coated. For the chocolate sauce, combine chocolate chips and heavy cream in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring until smooth and melted. Stir in vanilla extract.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Serve the warm, crispy churros with the rich, warm chocolate dipping sauce on the side. Enjoy this delightful Mexican dessert!

tips: For extra crispy churros, ensure your oil is at the correct temperature (350F/175C) and does not drop too low when adding dough. Use a thermometer.
Do not overmix the dough after adding the flour, just until it forms a ball. Overmixing can develop gluten too much, leading to tough churros.
Churros are best enjoyed fresh and warm. If you have leftovers, reheat them briefly in an oven or air fryer to regain crispness.
